actions.description: Isolate an endpoint from the network via EDR to stop lateral movement.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier from the alert, never a file path. Only propose when the alert identifies the affected endpoint.

actions.description: Block an IP address at the firewall/XDR to stop C2 or exfiltration traffic.
actions.planning_guidance: Use only an IP address explicitly present in the alert and associated with the suspicious activity.

actions.description: Block network traffic to or from a suspicious IP, domain, port, or protocol at the firewall/XDR.
actions.planning_guidance: Use one explicit IP, CIDR, domain, URL, or protocol/port indicator from the alert. Prefer a more specific block_ip, block_domain, or block_url action when possible.

actions.description: Block resolution or network access to a suspicious or malicious domain through DNS, firewall, or secure web gateway controls.
actions.planning_guidance: Use only the domain explicitly identified as malicious in the alert; do not use an email address or full URL.

actions.description: Block access to a specific malicious URL through the secure web gateway or proxy.
actions.planning_guidance: Use the exact HTTP or HTTPS URL from the alert, not a domain or email address.

actions.description: Increase monitoring of network connections created by processes on the affected host.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier, not a file path or process name.

actions.description: Enable SSL/TLS inspection for the relevant traffic scope to detect encrypted C2 communication.
actions.planning_guidance: Specify a narrowly scoped network or proxy policy scope supported by the alert; do not suggest enabling inspection globally.

actions.description: Collect and review PowerShell execution history and command-line telemetry on the affected host.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier from the alert.

actions.description: Collect relevant endpoint artifacts such as process lists, autoruns, event logs, network connections, and suspicious files for investigation.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier, not a directory or file path. Do not infer that a file was executed.

actions.description: Capture a memory image from the affected endpoint for forensic analysis.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier. Only propose when memory acquisition is supported and relevant to the alert.

actions.description: Create enhanced logging and alerting for unusual inbound or outbound data flows from the affected host.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier from the alert.

actions.description: Terminate a malicious process on the affected host.
actions.planning_guidance: Provide both a process name or ID as target and the affected endpoint identifier. Only propose when process execution is evidenced; do not infer execution from a file being present or downloaded.

actions.description: Quarantine a malicious file/artifact detected on the host.
actions.planning_guidance: Provide the exact file path or hash as target and the affected endpoint identifier. Use only file references present in the alert.

actions.description: Remove a confirmed malicious file from the affected host.
actions.planning_guidance: Provide the exact absolute file path and endpoint identifier. Only propose for a confirmed malicious file; prefer quarantine when preserving evidence matters.

actions.description: Disable a compromised user/service account in the IdP.
actions.planning_guidance: Use the exact user or service account identifier explicitly implicated by the alert.

actions.description: Revoke active authentication sessions and refresh tokens for a potentially compromised account.
actions.planning_guidance: Use the exact account identifier explicitly implicated by the alert.

actions.description: Force a credential reset for a compromised account.
actions.planning_guidance: Use the exact account identifier explicitly implicated by the alert; do not infer an account from an email sender.

actions.description: Disable a confirmed malicious persistence mechanism such as a scheduled task, service, startup item, or autorun entry.
actions.planning_guidance: Provide the exact persistence item and endpoint identifier. Only propose when the persistence mechanism is evidenced by the alert.

actions.description: Block execution of a known malicious file hash through EDR or application control.
actions.planning_guidance: Use an exact MD5, SHA1, or SHA256 hash from the alert, not a path or filename.

actions.description: Start an on-demand EDR/antimalware scan on the affected endpoint.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier from the alert, not a file or directory path.

actions.description: Temporarily increase endpoint telemetry and process, authentication, and network event collection for the affected host.
actions.planning_guidance: Use a host or EDR endpoint identifier from the alert.

actions.description: Escalate the incident to a human SOC analyst without taking automated action.
actions.planning_guidance: Do not include target or other action parameters; the incident itself is the notification context.

actions.description: No remediation required, close as benign/false positive.
actions.planning_guidance: Use only when the alert evidence supports a benign or false-positive conclusion. Do not combine with other actions.
